papers.title: High-efficiency MAPbI3 perovskite solar cells
papers.abstract: We report MAPbI3 based solar cells with optimized annealing at 100°C. The optical bandgap of MAPbI3 is measured as 1.55 eV.

sections.abstract: We report MAPbI3 based solar cells with optimized annealing at 100°C. The optical bandgap of MAPbI3 is measured as 1.55 eV.
sections.methods: First-principles DFT calculations were performed using PBE functional to relax the MAPbI3 lattice.
sections.results: MAPbI3 shows a bandgap of 1.55 eV and decent phase stability under standard conditions.

papers.title: Thermal stability of FAPbI3 perovskites
papers.abstract: FAPbI3 exhibits a bandgap of 1.48 eV. We study its stability using molecular dynamics at 300 K.

sections.abstract: FAPbI3 exhibits a bandgap of 1.48 eV. We study its stability using molecular dynamics at 300 K.
sections.methods: Molecular dynamics simulations reveal that FAPbI3 remains stable over 10 ns.
sections.results: The Eg of FAPbI3 is 1.48 eV, slightly lower than MAPbI3, with improved thermal tolerance.

papers.title: Mixed-cation MA0.8Cs0.2PbI3 for reduced hysteresis
papers.abstract: MA0.8Cs0.2PbI3 demonstrates a bandgap of 1.60 eV. DFT with HSE06 was used to validate the trend.

sections.abstract: MA0.8Cs0.2PbI3 demonstrates a bandgap of 1.60 eV. DFT with HSE06 was used to validate the trend.
sections.methods: HSE06 hybrid functional calculations confirm the Eg of MA0.8Cs0.2PbI3 at 1.60 eV.
sections.results: Incorporating Cs into MAPbI3 shifts the bandgap to 1.60 eV and suppresses ion migration.

papers.title: Defect engineering in MAPbI3 for tandem applications
papers.abstract: Through defect passivation, MAPbI3 shows an optical bandgap of 1.70 eV in our measurements. DFT supports the band alignment.

sections.abstract: Through defect passivation, MAPbI3 shows an optical bandgap of 1.70 eV in our measurements. DFT supports the band alignment.
sections.methods: First-principles DFT was applied to MAPbI3 with and without defects.
sections.results: The measured Eg of MAPbI3 reaches 1.70 eV after surface treatment, higher than the pristine value.

papers.title: Synthesis of CsPbBr3 nanocrystals
papers.abstract: CsPbBr3 perovskite nanocrystals were synthesized via hot-injection at 180°C. The emission is in the green region.

sections.abstract: CsPbBr3 perovskite nanocrystals were synthesized via hot-injection at 180°C. The emission is in the green region.
sections.methods: Hot-injection method produced uniform CsPbBr3 perovskite quantum dots.
sections.results: CsPbBr3 perovskite exhibits bright green photoluminescence but the precise bandgap was not quantified in this work.

papers.title: FA0.83Cs0.17PbI3 for stable single-junction devices
papers.abstract: FA0.83Cs0.17PbI3 yields a bandgap of 1.50 eV, close to the ideal 1.3-1.4 eV window. DFT confirms stability.

sections.abstract: FA0.83Cs0.17PbI3 yields a bandgap of 1.50 eV, close to the ideal 1.3-1.4 eV window. DFT confirms stability.
sections.methods: DFT calculations were used to assess the phase stability of FA0.83Cs0.17PbI3.
sections.results: FA0.83Cs0.17PbI3 achieves 1.50 eV bandgap with enhanced humidity stability.
